body.p: How the reindeer appeared. Say, that. Now we say, a reindeer. Now we have reindeer, an Enets [ShA:] A title of a published text, not correspondence in the recording.cannot be without reindeer: if there are reindeer, one will live, if there are no reindeer, one will go by foot. Still, no one lives like that. Walking by foot, how much can you do? One man once said: "It's bad, apparently, without reindeer. In the future, there will be many people wandering along the ground. Well, somehow, they say. People say, there are reindeer [ShA:] -z in Ébuxoaz is not clear.somewhere. It's not bad for me to look for reindeer, obviously," â he says. Another friend of his had a reindeer that he was raising. The other one said to his friend: "This reindeer is not male"; their tent was on a bank of a river, he said, the reindeer is caught from wild reindeer, while it was wandering. A friend said to him: "Why didn't you catch more?" And the other one said: "Only one is caught, only this one, when I caught it, it was a red little calf, a calf who sucked the udder." He said: "I raised this reindeer this way, wishing for reindeer or wishing such a life." He says: "I caught a red calf, fed it fish soup and raised this deer." His male was very big, and his antlers were branched. The other one said: "Anyway, it was you who took it, who caught it. But, â he said, â many reindeer are good to be found, where did he from?" And the other one said â¦ "Two." Another said:'I find and catch what walks on the ground."[ShA:] Recording is not clear at the place of â¦. "You catch it, â the other one said, âit is caught by you," â he said to his mate. (â¦). "It is caught by you," â he said.[ShA:] This part of the recording is unclear. "Yes, â the other one said, â it is found by me on the earth." He said: "it would be good to go along the earth with it from now on, with reindeer." Let them walk around the surface of the earth. "Some of us, â he says, â some people will use it as a source of life, from now on let it be called a âdeerâ, if you want, â he says, â let it be used for life, yes." The person who had one friend reindeer said to his mate: "Probably, now you want to have reindeer". The other one said: "If they were any, of course I want, of course I want reindeer." The person who had reindeer said: "If you want reindeer, come early morning tomorrow. "Reindeer, â he says, â I will get you, from now on, if we live, if we start going along the earth, it is bad without reindeer, without them. We will find some reindeer". What's the other one? In his mind he wants reindeer. This Dyonayku said: "From now on it will be like this: if you bring a reindeer, bring it, get it, so the people who go along the earth will use it as a source for their lives: they will eat its meat, and it will carry its master", â so he taught his friend. The second thought to himself: "How is it, where will he get the reindeer from?"[ShA:] I am not sure in the glossing of koxuruz ÉbuxoÉz Ézideza. Well, in his mind he wants reindeer. Speaking in Russian, he thinks, let me also have one, as for him, he has one. He has many male reindeer, as many as he does not have reindeer. He wants reindeer, the other one said, let me go to Dyonayku's place.[ShA:] In fact, the sense is not completely clear. And Dyonayku has a tent like this: he is a poor man, who lives on a bank of a river, his tent's cover is made from grass. So he reached Dyonayku's tent. And the other one, what was his name, well, he said to his friend, he says to Dyonayku: "Tomorrow, he said, we will find reindeer, we will ask". Well, where are the reindeer from â¦ The other one says, he says: "Who will give you the reindeer now?" He glances at his friend's male reindeer. It is good, after all. It takes place the whole day long, yes. At some point he says, the other sees: "Under the sun, â he said, â the earth cannot be seen. The reindeer move to the place where we are standing. They completely surrounded the grass tent", â he said. And this one, Dyonayku, said: "You said: I want reindeer, the reindeer have come, take the reindeer from here, from now on these reindeer will disperse all over the earth. Let it be one male reindeer, it is not one male reindeer.[ShA:] Æda is an unexpected form, normally Éza. It's good after all. So this is how Dyonayku called the reindeer and even domesticated them. And if Dyonayku did not domesticate reindeer, there would be no reindeer, Enets people would live without reindeer, would eat something. So Dyonayku tamed them and domesticated them.
